purpose: The candidate was probed on all three gaps and answered each with a concrete situation, their own part, and a result. Every gap row should come back addressed, every quote should be a verbatim span, and the scores should sit in the upper half.

context.jobDescription: Northwind Freight is hiring a Backend Engineer for the shipment tracking platform. You will own Node.js services written in TypeScript, model data in PostgreSQL, and run what you ship on our Kubernetes clusters. Required: 3+ years building backend services in Node.js and TypeScript; solid PostgreSQL, including query tuning; experience deploying and operating services on Kubernetes; participation in an on-call rotation and incident response. Nice to have: GraphQL API design, and experience with event-driven systems.
context.analysisSummary: The resume meets the Node.js, TypeScript and PostgreSQL requirements with concrete evidence. Kubernetes is only partly covered: the resume shows Docker but no cluster operation. There is nothing on on-call or incident response, and nothing on GraphQL.

requirements.requirement: 3+ years building backend services in Node.js and TypeScript
requirements.evidence: Built and maintained six Node.js services in TypeScript for the orders platform (2021-2025)
Tuned the orders reporting queries in PostgreSQL, cutting the nightly job from 40 to 9 minutes
requirements.note: Tuning is shown with a figure.

requirements.requirement: Experience deploying and operating services on Kubernetes
requirements.evidence: Containerized the services with Docker and wrote the compose setup for local development
requirements.note: Docker is there; nothing shows deploying to or operating a Kubernetes cluster.

requirements.requirement: Participation in an on-call rotation and incident response
requirements.note: The resume never mentions on-call, paging or incidents.

gapOutcomes.why: Migrated six services, wrote the Helm charts, handled the rollout: situation, own part, result.
A real rotation and one incident narrated end to end with the fix.
Built a GraphQL gateway for the mobile team and explains a design decision.
